purpose: Run the current clean acquisition-to-table pipeline with the explicitly declared original binary64 input reconstruction. This descriptor supersedes the packaging-only entry point without modifying its bytes.

supersedes.reason: The earlier descriptor pins producer 0e544883 and predates the independently diagnosed one-ULP decoding replay. Keep it as historical packaging provenance; its current-producer assertion is no longer the active command.

prerequisites: Use the full source checkout with its committed strengthening artifacts, not just a downloaded research-output artifact.
Match CI Python 3.11.9 and install requirements-strengthening.txt plus torch==2.10.0 from https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu in the active interpreter.
Network access is required for the public detector source closure, canonical raw archive and pinned TimeEval source archive. No paid resources are required.
The output directory must not exist. The driver creates fresh protocols, generated scores and study outputs without overwriting historical receipts.

ordered_commands.purpose: Acquire exact sources/raw data, generate fresh profiles, audit inputs, and execute both measured studies with fresh per-host protocols

optional_archive_argument: Append --archive cache/TSB-AD-U.zip to reuse only the checksum-bound raw archive; all detector scores are still generated afresh.
decoding_disclosure: The one-ULP rule was added after the failed Linux input replay and remote diagnostic, before fresh Linux fits. It reconstructs the original frozen Mac binary64 input while retaining all original raw/label/exact-observation/normalized-observation hashes; it was not an original Mac preregistration and does not change historical scores or timings.
historical_recovery: The original Mac generator and metadata-only recovery remain hash-bound in the source checkout and mapping.json. New runs execute neither historical file. The current producer includes the cache-symlink packaging fix and pins itself plus the decoding descriptor before its first detector fit.
fresh_outputs: .cache/strengthening-clean-replay/artifacts/pvldb-research-20261024/strengthening contains new generation, input audit, weighted study, native consumer and output audit receipts; raw data and scores remain under the private fresh cache.
limits: This descriptor is a reviewable entry point, not an outcome or experiment receipt. Fresh host scores may differ through numerical libraries and are independently hash-bound. Host timings are not pooled. The CI research artifact excludes original observations and detector score vectors, and does not constitute a self-contained historical raw-data archive.
